text:
kai_m: heads-up: telemetry alerted on engine-bundle v2026-04-qk4 in regional canary. p95 drift +35% on long tail requests after the allocator change.

neha_s: which region and what fraction?

kai_m: eu-west night-canal, 0.5% traffic. anomaly started ~01:42. deploy id `v2026-04-qk4+matmul-shim`.

tom_b: was the `quant-lite` path enabled? that had the new free-list optimization.

neha_s: yes PR mentions free-list + slab reclaim for tiled matmul. thought it reduced mem in benchmarks.

kai_m: benchmarks used seq<=2k. production has >4k tails. looks like fragmentation grows with longer sequence.

release-coordinator: suggested immediate mitigations: (1) pause further rollouts, (2) revert canary to previous bundle, or (3) enable allocator-fallback flag remotely if runtime supports it. which is fastest?

tom_b: enabling fallback is quickest if the runtime flag exists. i pushed a feature flag in the bundle but remote toggle is only in dedicated builds. not present in hosted canary.

neha_s: fallback toggle not available. revert canary to v2026-03-qk2?

deploybot: action options: `revert-bundle --target=eu-west-canary --version=v2026-03-qk2` OR `pause-rollout --target=eu-west-canary`.

kai_m: pause first to avoid churn. then run an extended smoke with seq 6k/10k against a debug build with early-free aggressive.

opsbot: pausing rollout... done. traffic ingress frozen for canary slices. routing weight set to previous stable. monitoring alerts will notify on new deltas.

neha_s: creating a quick release-note stub for comms: 
"v2026-04-qk4 (tiled matmul, allocator refactor) temporarily paused in eu-west canary due to increased memory pressure on long sequences. investigating; will update when we have a fix."

kai_m: agreed. also put an internal blurb about the rollback criteria: p95 > baseline *1.3 for 10m OR OOMs >=1 in 5m OR failed warmstart >2 in 15m triggers immediate revert.

tom_b: adding CPU/GPU resident snapshot capture to extended smoke. opsbot please run: `ops smoke --bundle v2026-04-qk4 --nodes=3 --seqlens=6144,10240 --dur=600 --collect=mem,res,p95,p99,ooms,warms`

opsbot: smoke task queued. ETA 10m. link: https://internal.run/smoke/1743214321-ext

opsbot: smoke results: 6144 -> p95 +18% mem +12% no OOMs; 10240 -> p95 +48% mem +46% 1 OOM g2-eu-07 and 3 failed warmstarts. detailed logs: https://internal.run/smoke/1743214321-ext/logs

neha_s: reproduces on 10k. not safe to continue. can we do an automated revert now?

deply_typo: (typo)

deploybot: executing revert: `revert-bundle --target=eu-west-canary --version=v2026-03-qk2 --reason="mem pressure at seq>8k"`

deploybot: revert complete. routing updated. confirm monitoring back to baseline?

kai_m: monitoring shows p95 returned near baseline within 2 mins. OOMs ceased. good.

release-coordinator: next steps: (1) open a postmortem ticket referencing the PR that introduced allocator refactor, (2) request a debug build with slab reclaim disabled + early-free patch, (3) run long-tail perf harness before reattempt, and (4) add a runtime feature flag for allocator-fallback for future quick toggles.

tom_b: will author the debug build PR and include perf snapshots. marking it high priority.

neha_s: i'll update the release notes and notify product + support. draft public line: "We paused a limited canary for v2026-04-qk4 due to memory pressure on very long sequences; customers not affected broadly; patch planned and we will re-roll after extended validation."

kai_m: closing thread. pinned revert active for 4h to allow for continued monitoring and patch work. opsbot subscribe to regressions and OOMs.

opsbot: subscribed. will escalate to @oncall if OOM >0 in any region or p95 > baseline *1.25 for 15m.
